Clear picture at small card size, with calm dark/light masses; effects localized, environmental light controlled, readable expressive character faces. CARD Mina Funda do Mar de Mercurio, COMMON Sublimeyn Structure. Reference 1 gives a deep silver mine with timber beams, rail tracks, ore carts and sparse lanterns. A very large lateral natural cave opening upper RIGHT reveals the fantastical calm MERCURY-SILVER SEA far below, floating dark islands and two thin cloud layers, blue/mauve afternoon sky; warm late afternoon daylight softly touches the rock lips, not blazing gold. Long thin SILVER vapor descends gently off a beam and crystallizes into a few tiny droplets, localized current Sublimeyn ambience with NO resource spheres. Enough cave depth to remain Mina Funda, not open beach quarry. SILVER physical ore is distinct solid facets from silver thin magic vapor and smooth liquid sea. Broad smoothly painted planes, restrained deliberate details, no dense rough stone marks or HDR/bright gold fog. EMPTY card rules: NO attack, draw, activation, healing, summoning or portals. 3 pitch resource is metadata, no invented power. No UI, foil, words, frame, white margins or cutout; finished continuous opaque portrait environment.
